cumleler: Does damage to the balance organs always cause vertigo?
Some aminoglycosides, such as gentamicin, tend to damage the balance organs more.
Because damage is similar on both sides, vertigo attacks are often absent.
People mainly report imbalance in the dark and on uneven ground.
Bouncing vision with head movement, called oscillopsia, is a typical complaint.
In bedbound patients, this may go unnoticed until discharge.
